Every truss member (chords, posts, diagonals) carries one callout 'rectangular tube Ø-100x50x2.0 mm.'; the slashed symbol is read as a rectangular hollow section (designation RHS), print kept in printed_as. The member the trusses sit on is called out 'อะเส rectangular tube Ø-150x50x2.0 mm.' (the S-02 ring at +3.41), recorded as bottom_chord_printed_as.

The truss panel chains (1.50 x4 / 1.50 x2 / 1.00 x3 / 0.90 x5) print no grid bubble under them, so per section 4 rule 4 they are floating detail dimensions: kept on the truss elements (panel_lengths_printed_as), not in the grid master. Supports are named from the S-03 plan positions.
